transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for being here. As we all know, the DOJ has issued a subpoena regarding commission payments made through our international distributors, and we need to submit our initial response and proposed investigation plan next month. The draft currently on the table describes the matter as involving international distributor commissions and proposes preserving relevant records and interviewing implicated personnel. Before I can sign off on this submission, I want to use our standard legal-review roundtable to make sure we have a solid factual basis for every proposed response term. I'd like to go around the table and hear from each of you on what you know relevant to this matter. Let's start with what we have and identify any gaps before we finalize anything.
